name: Sword Arena
hook: Swing, block, roll. Last knight standing scores.
how: Knights fight on a floating stone arena. Three swings in a row end in a big overhead hit, a raised shield stops a swing and leaves the attacker reeling, and a roll dodges anything. Knock a rival out or off the edge; first to 5 knockouts wins.
controls: WASD and mouse, click to swing, hold right-click or Shift to block, Space to roll. On a phone: left thumb moves, drag to look, SWING, BLOCK and ROLL buttons
uses: The most knockouts anyone has scored in one match.
One player's browser counts the knockouts, runs the clock and calls the winner; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Bot knights circle, swing, block and roll until enough people join.
Every swing, block and roll shows up for everyone at once.
ideas: Give everyone a bow for a ranged attack
Make the arena shrink as the match goes on
Add a power-up that makes your sword huge
